description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Order to amend the Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 1992/29 of 10.11.2016 published under the Excise (Special Provisions) Act
categorisation: This gazette content is an order amending a schedule under the Excise (Special Provisions) Act, No. 13 of 1989. It involves regulatory changes to excise duty provisions, specifically modifying tax regulations for vehicle purchases/imports by diplomatic officers. This falls under Legal/Regulatory classification as it deals with statutory instruments and regulatory modifications to existing legislation.
